svg.text: WHERE IT WORKS TODAY
11 provinces of Huánuco · 23 NASA grid cells (0.5° × 0.625°) · outlines: geoBoundaries, CC BY 4.0
WHAT IT CHANGES
1 season
a year in the highlands. NASA rain shows 8 wet months
at 3,400 m: one sowing, one chance.
+13 points
of expected harvest when the current rotation is swapped
for the Andean one: 61% → 74% on the same field.
0 bytes
to get an answer once the data is on the phone.
Spanish and Quechua, no account, no sign-up.
WHERE LOCAL EXPERTISE COMES IN
The tool supports the farmer, it does not replace them. Crop
coefficients, altitude ranges and sowing months are FAO and INIA
references; an agronomist tunes them to Huánuco fields.
